headline: Tencent's hy4 extends its all-time token-share record to a second day, at 9.7%
summary: Tencent's hy4 is on day 2 of its all-time token-share record at 9.7%, sitting at No. 2 behind DeepSeek's flash model. Upstage's solar-pro4 and OpenAI's gpt-oss-120b made their first appearances at ranks 45 and 51, while two models fell off the list.
highlights: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 still holds No. 1 with 25.0% of tokens, and it has kept that rank for the past week.
anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5-20260928 was the biggest climber, up 6 places to No. 14.
New entrants: upstage/solar-pro4-20260810 at No. 45 and openai/gpt-oss-120b at No. 51.
Dropouts: tencent/hy4-preview-20260827 (last ranked 34) and openai/gpt-5.6-sol-20260709 (last ranked 49).
DeepSeek and Tencent together hold 47.0% of tokens, with DeepSeek alone at 36.3%.
